snippet.title: Five Nights Before Freddy's - New Game Mechanic Showcase
snippet.description:
With the return to development of FNBF, a new game mechanic has been made, 5 hours in and we have an original mechanic. When it fades to black at 1.00 in this video it is a dramatization of future development.
